consumer: The find-item quest's possession gate, i.e. the dialogue/condition check (condition.cpp::set_has_items, u_has_items/npc_has_items) asking yes/no: does the character actor have item flashlight?
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person: wielded/worn/inventory), matching the possession predicate's reach
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — its body builds a lambda over the character actor returning actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count), an engine-COMPUTED yes/no the quest gate consumes
divergence: The flashlight lies on the adjacent ground tile (not carried): the on-person gate must return false, but a reachable-nearby or display-snapshot answer would wrongly report possession and open the gate
